claims.statement: The profile-customization navigation includes README management, pinning and private-profile settings under broad FPT/GHEC/GHES metadata. Child eligibility remains narrower; navigation is not permission to publish or change profile visibility.

Profile READMEs are unavailable to enterprise managed users despite broad product metadata. Display requires a public repository exactly matching the username, a root README.md and nonempty content; file existence alone is insufficient.

Public matching-name repositories created before July 2020 do not automatically display their README; Share to profile is a manual opt-in step. Repository creation date and actual displayed behavior require separate evidence.

The resolved creation flow opens New repository, uses the matching username as name, optionally adds a description, selects Public, enables Add README and creates the repository before editing the generated README. These publication steps require applicable approval; inspirational templates and example identities are not deployable truth.

Profile README display is removed if the README is deleted or emptied, the repository becomes private, or repository and username no longer match. The source recommends private visibility if unsure, but visibility changes affect a repository beyond its profile rendering and are not authorized here.

Emoji cheat-sheet and profile-reference links are pointers, not imported external corpora or verified runtime receipts. No README publication, repository creation, deletion, rename or visibility change occurs in this review.

Across FPT/GHEC/GHES the pinning procedure opens the user's profile, Customize your pins, optionally filters repositories and gists, optionally reorders by dragging, selects at most six repositories and gists combined, then saves. Six is a combined limit, not six of each type.

Pins are curated presentation, not exhaustive repository inventory, ownership proof or repository-access enforcement. Selection, filtering and Save pins are procedural instructions, not evidence that an intended pin set is currently visible.

This procedure is FPT-only, not GHES or GHEC: Settings, Public profile, Contributions & Activity, Make profile private and hide activity, then Update preferences. A broad parent index cannot expand this product scope.

A private profile limits information and hides some activity; the concept and limitations references must not be replaced by a claim that all fields or repository access become private. Toggling or file existence does not prove actual observer-visible disclosure.
